<issue>
Document._body property returns None instead of _Body instance

#### Description

When accessing the `_body` property on a Document instance, it returns `None` instead of the expected `_Body` instance. This breaks functionality that depends on accessing the document body.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from docx import Document

# Create a new document
doc = Document()

# Try to access the document body
body = doc._body
print(f"Body: {body}")  # Expected: <_Body instance>, Actual: None

# This will fail when trying to iterate content
try:
    content = list(doc.iter_inner_content())
    print(f"Content: {content}")
except AttributeError as e:
    print(f"Error: {e}")
```

The `_body` property should return a `_Body` instance but instead returns `None`, causing downstream operations that depend on the document body to fail.
</issue>
